title: 🔆🔅Tehran - September 19 - Ebrahim Azizi, Head of the National Security Commission of Iran's Parliament, gave an interview.
text:
🔆🔅Tehran - September 19 - Ebrahim Azizi, Head of the National Security Commission of Iran's Parliament, gave an interview."

"SOT1, Ebrahim Azizi, Head of the National Security Commission of Iran's Parliament (Farsi)-(00:00 - 00:12): "Today, this regional war means proving power through the credibility of the threats issued by the Islamic Republic of Iran; the world is now becoming sensitive to this reality.""

"SOT2, Ebrahim Azizi, Head of the National Security Commission of Iran's Parliament (Farsi)-(00:13 - 00:33): "The greatest achievement of this battle—apart from the fact that Islamic Iran has today managed to achieve all its demands in various sectors—is that this threat has been validated.""

"SOT3, Ebrahim Azizi, Head of the National Security Commission of Iran's Parliament (Farsi)-(00:34 - 00:51): "We no longer limit our defense and security environment to our own geographical borders; we do not see it that way. The Islamic Republic of Iran defines its defense and security environment as any point that is a source of threat to us or a potential threat.""

"SOT4, Ebrahim Azizi, Head of the National Security Commission of Iran's Parliament (Farsi)-(00:52 - 01:22): "Today, the countries of the region have concluded that security cannot be bought; they cannot simply pay money or provide oil and say, 'Define security and come provide it for us.' In short, the Islamic Republic has proven today that security cannot be defined by relying on the Americans—powers that seek wealth accumulation and the plundering of the region's assets.""

"SOT5, Ebrahim Azizi, Head of the National Security Commission of Iran's Parliament (Farsi)-(01:23 - 01:49): "The Americans are trapped; indeed, right now they feel that both paths—negotiation and war—are closed to them. Driving the Americans toward—and successfully driving them into—a strategic deadlock is something the United States is feeling with every fiber of its being.""

"SOT6, Ebrahim Azizi, Head of the National Security Commission of Iran's Parliament (Farsi)-(01:50 - 02:16): "The American economy, the American political landscape, the American social climate, the lies of the U.S. President, and the confusion of American commanders—particularly CENTCOM—if we put these together, it is completely clear that the Americans have become trapped in a political, economic, and military stalemate.""

"SOT7, Ebrahim Azizi, Head of the National Security Commission of Iran's Parliament (Farsi)-(02:17 - 02:27): "By provocation of the Zionist regime, the Americans entered the scene; had they wanted to handle this matter rationally, they might never have thought of attacking Iran.
